title: Human-Imitating Metrics for Training and Evaluating Privacy Preserving Emotion Recognition Models Using Sociolinguistic Knowledge
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on developing a metric to address the ethical problem of privacy preservation in machine learning models. It directly deals with how models learn and potentially misuse sensitive demographic information (gender), which constitutes a form of bias. The research aims to align model behavior with human trust and perception of privacy, making ethics a central component of the work rather than a peripheral consideration.
